title: Dyno rig
summary: Reusing Tekkai 1.0 control board to kickstart CupExS Drag Car development
mediaAlt: A purple printed motor-dyno fixture with its electronics.
content:
## 

Before I decide what the optimal gear ratio of the car, I need to measure the torque vs rpm characteristic of our DC motors. I printed a seperate stand and mount for a high precision magnetic encoder MT6701 which records wheel rotation. Measuring acceleration on the shaft gave me a power-rpm torque that revealed optimal rpm range that outputs maximum power.
